image_prompts: A family celebrating the Lantern Festival with red lanterns hanging from the eaves.
A child holding a small paper lantern with a candle inside, smiling.
words.image_desc_en: Red lanterns hanging during a festival celebration.
words.image_desc_cn: 节日庆祝中挂着的红灯笼。
words.collocations: paper lantern, Chinese lantern, light a lantern, carry a lantern

examples.en: During the Lantern Festival, people hang colorful lanterns outside their houses.
examples.cn: 元宵节期间，人们在家门外挂上五颜六色的灯笼。

examples.en: We took a paper lantern to light up our way in the dark.
examples.cn: 我们带了一个纸灯笼来照亮黑暗中的路。

socratic_questions.question: 如果让你设计一个灯笼迎接新年，你会用什么颜色和图案？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：想想灯笼的象征意义，比如红色代表好运。

sentences: At the night fair, children walked around holding bright ___.

image_prompts: A lost tourist asking a policeman for directions on a busy street.
A child looking nervously at an unfamiliar person approaching.
words.image_desc_en: A person asking a stranger for directions cautiously.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个人谨慎地向陌生人问路。
words.collocations: complete stranger, talk to a stranger, be a stranger to, trust a stranger

examples.en: It is not safe to accept gifts from a stranger.
examples.cn: 接受陌生人的礼物是不安全的。

examples.en: When I first moved to this city, I was a stranger to everyone.
examples.cn: 当我第一次搬到这个城市时，我对每个人都是陌生人。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你在街上迷路了，你会向陌生人问路吗？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：考虑安全因素，比如找警察或商店店员。

sentences: My mom told me never to get into a car with a ___.

image_prompts: A large family gathering around a dinner table during the Spring Festival.
Two cousins playing together in a living room with adults chatting.
words.image_desc_en: A family reunion with relatives celebrating together.
words.image_desc_cn: 亲戚们团聚庆祝的家庭聚会。
words.usage: n. 亲属；亲戚（可数名词）
words.collocations: close relative, distant relative, visit relatives, family relative

examples.en: We always visit our relatives during the Spring Festival.
examples.cn: 我们总是在春节期间拜访我们的亲戚。

examples.en: She is a distant relative of mine, but we seldom meet.
examples.cn: 她是我的远房亲戚，但我们很少见面。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要从亲戚中选一位一起过年，你会选谁？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 提示：想想谁和你关系好，或者谁家有趣。

sentences: During holidays, many people travel to see their ___ in other cities.

image_prompts: A young girl putting on a red scarf in front of a mirror.
A person standing on a scale, looking down with a worried expression.
words.image_desc_en: A girl putting on a scarf in front of a mirror.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个女孩在镜子前戴上围巾。
words.usage: 短语动词，意为“穿上；增加（体重）”。
words.collocations: put on weight, put on a show, put on clothes, put on a hat

examples.en: Please put on your coat before going outside.
examples.cn: 请在外面之前穿上你的外套。

examples.en: She has put on a lot of weight during the holidays.
examples.cn: 假期里她体重增加了很多。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么“put on”既可以表示“穿上”又可以表示“增加体重”？这两个意思有什么共同点？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想“put on”字面意思是“放上去”，穿衣是把衣服放身上，增重是把重量放身上。

sentences: It's cold outside. Please ___ your hat and gloves.

image_prompts: A hand holding a one-pound coin, with a price tag showing £5.
A digital scale displaying 2.2 pounds of tomatoes.
words.image_desc_en: A hand holding a one-pound coin and a price tag.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只手拿着一枚一英镑硬币和一张价格标签。
words.usage: n. 磅（重量单位）；英镑（货币单位）。
words.collocations: pound coin, pound sterling, a pound of, per pound

examples.en: I spent ten pounds on this magazine.
examples.cn: 我花了十英镑买这本杂志。

examples.en: The baby weighed seven pounds at birth.
examples.cn: 这个婴儿出生时重七磅。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么同一个单词“pound”既能表示重量又能表示货币？你能从历史或文化角度猜一猜吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 最初一英镑就是等于一磅银子的价值，所以重量和货币产生了关联。

sentences: How many ___ does this bag of apples weigh?

image_prompts: A group of people dancing a traditional folk dance in colorful costumes.
An old man playing a folk guitar in a small village square.
words.image_desc_en: People dancing a traditional folk dance in costumes.
words.image_desc_cn: 人们穿着传统服装跳民间舞蹈。
words.collocations: folk music, folk art, folk tale, folk dance

examples.en: We learned a folk song in music class today.
examples.cn: 今天音乐课我们学了一首民歌。

examples.en: Many folk tales have been passed down for generations.
examples.cn: 许多民间故事已经传承了好几代。

socratic_questions.question: “folk”经常与“music”、“tale”等词搭配，你认为“folk”的核心含义是什么？它和“popular”有什么区别？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: “folk”强调是普通百姓的、传统的，而“popular”可能只是当下流行的。

sentences: My grandmother loves listening to ___ music from her hometown.

image_prompts: A marble statue of a beautiful woman with wings, holding a torch.
A movie scene of a golden-haired goddess descending from the sky.
words.image_desc_en: A marble statue of a winged goddess holding a torch.
words.image_desc_cn: 一尊手持火炬的有翼女神大理石雕像。
words.collocations: love goddess, goddess of beauty, Greek goddess, moon goddess

examples.en: In Greek myths, Athena is the goddess of wisdom.
examples.cn: 在希腊神话中，雅典娜是智慧女神。

examples.en: They built a temple to honor the goddess of the moon.
examples.cn: 他们建造了一座神庙来纪念月亮女神。

socratic_questions.question: “goddess”是“女神”，那它的对应阳性词是什么？你能想到哪些著名的女神？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 对应阳性词是“god”（神）。比如爱神维纳斯（Venus）、月亮女神阿尔忒弥斯（Artemis）。

sentences: In the story, the ___ helped the hero find the magic sword.

image_prompts: A man in a mask reaching into another person's backpack in a crowded square.
A cartoon fox sneaking away with a piece of cheese from a windowsill.
words.image_desc_en: A masked man stealing from a backpack in a crowd.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个戴面具的人在人群中从背包里偷东西。
words.collocations: steal money, steal food, steal a glance, steal the show

examples.en: Someone stole my phone on the bus.
examples.cn: 有人在公交车上偷了我的手机。

examples.en: He tried to steal a glance at the answers during the test.
examples.cn: 他试图在考试中偷看答案。

socratic_questions.question: “steal”和“rob”都有“偷”的意思，但用法不同。你能说说它们的主要区别吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: steal 强调物品被偷，常用 steal sth from sb/place；rob 强调人或地方被抢，常用 rob sb/place of sth.

sentences: The thief tried to ___ the woman's purse in the crowd.

image_prompts: A farmer carefully places eggs in a straw-lined basket in a coop.
A student spreads a colorful map on a wooden school desk.
words.image_desc_en: A farmer places eggs in a basket; a student spreads a map on a desk.
words.image_desc_cn: 农夫把鸡蛋放入篮中；学生把地图摊在课桌上。
words.collocations: lay eggs, lay the table, lay a foundation, lay down
words.preposition_combos: lay on, lay in, lay out

examples.en: The hen laid three eggs this morning.
examples.cn: 母鸡今早下了三个蛋。

examples.en: Please lay the map on the desk so everyone can see it.
examples.cn: 请把地图铺在桌上，这样大家都能看到。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你要说“她把宝宝放在床上”，用lay怎么表达？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 注意lay的过去式是laid，这里用She laid the baby on the bed.

sentences: The mother bird ____ her eggs in the nest.

image_prompts: A teenager neatly arranges books and stationery on a study desk.
Gardeners laying out a new flower bed with colorful tulips in a park.
words.image_desc_en: A teenager arranges stationery on a desk; gardeners arrange tulips in a flower bed.
words.image_desc_cn: 青少年在桌上摆放文具；园丁在花坛里布置郁金香。
words.usage: 短语动词 摆开；布置；设计
words.collocations: lay out clothes, lay out a garden, lay out a plan

examples.en: I will lay out my school uniform on the bed before going to sleep.
examples.cn: 睡觉前我会把校服摆放在床上。

examples.en: The designer laid out the whole park with a pond and flower beds.
examples.cn: 设计师布置了整个公园，有水塘和花坛。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么说“lay out”强调的不仅是放东西，还有安排？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为out有“展开、展示”的意思，所以lay out常指有秩序地摆放或设计。

sentences: Before the party, we need to ____ the snacks and drinks on the table.

image_prompts: A slice of chocolate cake with whipped cream on a plate at a school cafeteria.
A bowl of fresh strawberries and yogurt being served as dessert at home.
words.image_desc_en: A slice of chocolate cake in a cafeteria; a bowl of strawberries and yogurt at home.
words.image_desc_cn: 学校食堂里的一块巧克力蛋糕；家里的一碗草莓酸奶。
words.collocations: have dessert, chocolate dessert, fruit dessert, dessert menu

examples.en: After lunch, we had ice cream as dessert.
examples.cn: 午饭后，我们吃了冰淇淋作甜点。

examples.en: The restaurant offers a wide variety of desserts, including cake and pudding.
examples.cn: 这家餐厅提供多种甜点，包括蛋糕和布丁。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你甜点吃太多了，会有什么后果？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可能会觉得太饱或者糖分摄入过多，对健康不好。

sentences: For ____, we can choose between apple pie and chocolate mousse.

image_prompts: A student watering colorful flowers with a watering can in a school garden.
A peaceful backyard garden with a small bench under a cherry tree.
words.image_desc_en: A student watering flowers; a backyard garden with a bench and cherry tree.
words.image_desc_cn: 学生在花园里浇花；后院花园中樱桃树下的长椅。
words.collocations: flower garden, vegetable garden, garden path, garden party

examples.en: We grow tomatoes and carrots in our school garden.
examples.cn: 我们在学校的花园里种西红柿和胡萝卜。

examples.en: My grandmother loves to sit in the garden and read books on sunny afternoons.
examples.cn: 我奶奶喜欢在晴朗的下午坐在花园里看书。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你有一个小花园，你会种些什么？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以种花或者蔬菜，比如玫瑰让花园漂亮，生菜能吃。

sentences: My aunt spends every morning watering her roses in the ____.

image_prompts: Students standing in front of a Van Gogh painting in a school art exhibition.
A girl looks up at the night sky, admiring the twinkling stars from her balcony.
words.image_desc_en: Students viewing a painting; a girl stargazing from a balcony.
words.image_desc_cn: 学生在画作前欣赏；女孩在阳台上仰望星空。
words.collocations: admire the view, admire someone, admire a painting, admire greatly

examples.en: We stopped at the hilltop to admire the beautiful sunset.
examples.cn: 我们在山顶停下来欣赏美丽的日落。

examples.en: I really admire my math teacher because she explains things so clearly.
examples.cn: 我真的很钦佩我的数学老师，因为她讲解得非常清楚。

socratic_questions.question: 你觉得“admire”和“like”有什么不同？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: admire含有更多的尊重和敬佩，而like只是喜欢。

sentences: Many tourists come to this museum to ____ the famous paintings.

image_prompts: A boy tying his school tie in front of a mirror.
A sailor tying a rope to a dock.
words.image_desc_en: A boy adjusting his tie.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个男孩正在整理领带。
words.collocations: tie a knot, tie the rope, tie up, tie with

examples.en: He wore a red tie to school.
examples.cn: 他戴着一条红领带去上学。

examples.en: Can you tie the garbage bag before taking it out?
examples.cn: 你能在扔垃圾前把垃圾袋系好吗？

socratic_questions.question: 为什么在一些正式场合人们需要系领带？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 领带代表尊重和礼貌，常见于商务或正式活动。

sentences: He ____ his shoelaces before running.

image_prompts: A dark, creepy old house with broken windows.
A ghostly figure floating in a hallway.
words.image_desc_en: An eerie old house at night.
words.image_desc_cn: 夜晚一座阴森的老房子。
words.collocations: haunted house, haunted castle, haunted forest, haunted hotel

examples.en: They went into a haunted house on Halloween.
examples.cn: 万圣节那天他们进了一间鬼屋。

examples.en: The old hotel is said to be haunted by a ghost.
examples.cn: 据说那家老酒店有鬼魂出没。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么很多人喜欢在万圣节参观鬼屋？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为刺激和冒险，也是万圣节的传统活动之一。

sentences: The abandoned mansion is ____.

image_prompts: A white sheet with two holes for eyes floating in the air.
A ghost appearing behind a person in a dark room.
words.image_desc_en: A classic Halloween ghost.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个经典的万圣节鬼魂。
words.collocations: ghost story, see a ghost, ghost town, ghost hunter

examples.en: We told ghost stories around the campfire.
examples.cn: 我们在篝火旁讲鬼故事。

examples.en: Some people believe they have seen a ghost in the attic.
examples.cn: 有些人相信他们在阁楼里见过鬼魂。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么许多人喜欢听鬼故事？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为好奇心和对超自然事物的刺激感。

sentences: I don't believe in ____.

image_prompts: A magician pulling a rabbit out of a hat.
A child putting a whoopee cushion on a chair.
words.image_desc_en: A magician performing a trick.
words.image_desc_cn: 魔术师正在表演戏法。
words.collocations: play a trick, magic trick, dirty trick, trick or treat

examples.en: The kids played a trick on their teacher by hiding her chalk.
examples.cn: 孩子们把老师的粉笔藏起来，跟她开了个玩笑。

examples.en: He learned a cool magic trick from a book.
examples.cn: 他从一本书里学了一个很酷的魔术。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么“trick or treat”是万圣节的传统活动？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 因为孩子们会挨家挨户要糖果，如果不给就用恶作剧报复。

sentences: She can do a clever card ____.

image_prompts: A hand giving a candy to a child in a costume.
A family enjoying a meal at a restaurant together.
words.image_desc_en: A child receiving candy from a neighbor.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个孩子从邻居那里收到糖果。
words.usage: n. 款待；v. 招待，请客
words.collocations: treat someone to, Halloween treat, treat as, treat with

examples.en: My mom treats me to ice cream after I finish my homework.
examples.cn: 我完成作业后妈妈请我吃冰淇淋。

examples.en: On Halloween, children get treats from neighbors.
examples.cn: 万圣节那天，孩子们从邻居那里得到款待。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么在万圣节人们会给孩子们糖果？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 这是“不给糖就捣蛋”的传统，用糖果避免被恶作剧。

sentences: I want to ____ my friends to dinner.

image_prompts: A spider weaving an intricate web between two branches in a garden.
A close-up of a spider's eyes and hairy legs on a leaf.
words.image_desc_en: A spider building a web in a garden.
words.image_desc_cn: 一只蜘蛛在花园里织网。
words.collocations: black widow, garden spider, spider web, spider bite

examples.en: I saw a spider spinning a web in the corner of the classroom.
examples.cn: 我看到一只蜘蛛在教室的角落里织网。

examples.en: Some people are afraid of spiders, but they actually help control insects.
examples.cn: 有些人害怕蜘蛛，但实际上它们有助于控制昆虫。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么蜘蛛网很坚韧？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 蜘蛛丝的蛋白质结构使其具有高强度和弹性。

sentences: The little girl screamed when she saw a ___ crawling on her desk.

image_prompts: A family decorating a Christmas tree with ornaments and a star on top.
A snowy village with houses lit by Christmas lights and a sleigh.
words.image_desc_en: A family decorating a Christmas tree.
words.image_desc_cn: 一家人装饰圣诞树。
words.collocations: Christmas tree, Christmas Eve, Merry Christmas, Christmas present

examples.en: We decorate the Christmas tree with colorful lights every year.
examples.cn: 每年我们都用彩灯装饰圣诞树。

examples.en: In many countries, families gather together for a big dinner on Christmas Day.
examples.cn: 在许多国家，家人在圣诞节当天聚在一起吃大餐。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么圣诞节在12月25日？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 与基督教传统和罗马的农神节有关。

sentences: We are going to visit our grandparents ___ Christmas.

image_prompts: A man with a jester hat and a silly grin, holding a whoopee cushion.
A child pretending to be a king while others laugh at his costume.
words.image_desc_en: A person dressed as a jester making a funny face.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个打扮成小丑的人做着鬼脸。
words.collocations: April Fools' Day, make a fool of, fool around, fool's gold

examples.en: Don't be such a fool! You should study harder for the exam.
examples.cn: 别这么傻了！你应该更努力学习准备考试。

examples.en: He tried to fool his friends with a magic trick.
examples.cn: 他试图用一个魔术戏法愚弄他的朋友们。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么人们要在愚人节互相开玩笑？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 愚人节的传统是捉弄别人，但要注意分寸。

sentences: On April 1st, it's common to play tricks and ___ your friends.

image_prompts: A person lying on a hammock between two trees, reading a book.
A dog lying on a rug, sleeping peacefully.
words.image_desc_en: A person lying in a hammock reading a book.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个人躺在吊床上看书。
words.collocations: lie down, lie in bed, lie on the grass, lie still
words.preposition_combos: lie on, lie in, lie under

examples.en: After running for one hour, I need to lie down and rest.
examples.cn: 跑步一小时后，我需要躺下休息。

examples.en: The cat likes to lie in the sun on the windowsill.
examples.cn: 这只猫喜欢躺在窗台上的阳光下。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么医生建议病人多躺下休息？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 躺下可以减少身体负担，帮助恢复。

sentences: I'm feeling tired, so I'm going to ___ on the sofa for a while.

image_prompts: A stack of old books with one open showing a map of a fantasy land.
A person sitting under a tree reading a thick novel with a cup of tea.
words.image_desc_en: A stack of books with one open to a fantasy map.
words.image_desc_cn: 一摞书，其中一本翻开显示幻想地图。
words.collocations: historical novel, detective novel, romance novel, write a novel

examples.en: Our English teacher asked us to read a novel and write a book report.
examples.cn: 我们的英语老师要求我们读一本小说并写一份读书报告。

examples.en: J.K. Rowling's Harry Potter series is one of the most popular novels in the world.
examples.cn: J.K.罗琳的哈利·波特系列是世界上最受欢迎的小说之一。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么小说比电影更让人有想象力？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 小说用文字描述，读者需要自己构建画面。

sentences: She spent the whole weekend reading an interesting ___.

image_prompts: A family sitting around a dinner table on Christmas Eve, with a decorated tree in the corner.
A student studying alone late at night on the eve of an important exam.
words.image_desc_en: A cozy living room with a Christmas tree and a family enjoying dinner on Christmas Eve.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个舒适的客厅，有圣诞树，一家人在圣诞前夜享用晚餐。
words.collocations: Christmas Eve, New Year's Eve, on the eve of, the eve of

examples.en: On New Year's Eve, my family watches the countdown together.
examples.cn: 新年前夜，我家一起看倒计时。

examples.en: The night before the final exam felt like the eve of a big battle.
examples.cn: 期末考试前夜感觉像一场大战的前夕。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么人们常说“除夕”是“the eve of the Spring Festival”？eve 在这里表达什么含义？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想“前夕”表示什么时间点，通常与重要日子相连。

sentences: We always have a big dinner on the ___ of the Chinese New Year.

image_prompts: A bright bookstore with shelves of books and a student reading near the window.
A small independent bookstore with a sign that says 'New Arrivals' and a cat sleeping on a stack of books.
words.image_desc_en: A tidy bookstore interior with wooden shelves, a young girl holding a book and smiling.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个整洁的书店内部，木制书架，一个年轻女孩拿着书微笑。
words.collocations: online bookstore, local bookstore, bookstore owner, go to the bookstore

examples.en: I walked to the bookstore after school to buy a new novel.
examples.cn: 放学后我走去书店买了一本新小说。

examples.en: The bookstore on the corner has a special section for English learners.
examples.cn: 拐角处那家书店有个专为英语学习者设置的专区。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一家 bookstore 既卖书又卖咖啡，还能坐着阅读，它还是“书店”吗？为什么？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 思考“bookstore”的核心是什么——销售书籍的地方，即使附加其他服务。

sentences: My favorite ___ is just five minutes away from our school.

image_prompts: A wilted flower lying on the ground, its petals brown and dry.
A smartphone screen showing a black battery icon with a red '0%'.
words.image_desc_en: A wilted rose with drooping petals on a wooden table.
words.image_desc_cn: 一朵凋谢的玫瑰，花瓣低垂，放在木桌上。
words.usage: adj. 死的；失去生命的；失效的
words.collocations: dead body, dead end, dead tired, dead serious

examples.en: The dead flowers were thrown away after the party.
examples.cn: 派对后枯死的花被扔掉了。

examples.en: My phone was dead, so I couldn't send you a message.
examples.cn: 我手机没电了，所以没法给你发信息。

socratic_questions.question: “dead”在“dead end”和“dead battery”中，意思有何不同？它们都表示“死”吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想“dead end”指道路不通，“dead battery”指电量耗尽，都是比喻“失去功能”。

sentences: The old tree in the garden was ___ after the storm.

image_prompts: Two businessmen shaking hands in a modern office, with a whiteboard showing graphs.
A person working on a laptop at a cafe with a coffee cup, looking at charts.
words.image_desc_en: A professional handshake between two men in suits in a bright meeting room.
words.image_desc_cn: 两位穿西装的男士在明亮的会议室里专业地握手。
words.collocations: do business, business trip, business plan, none of your business

examples.en: My father has a small business selling handmade crafts.
examples.cn: 我父亲经营一家小生意，卖手工制品。

examples.en: Please focus on your own business and stop interfering.
examples.cn: 请管好你自己的事，别来干涉。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么说“It's none of your business”中的business不是指“商业”，而是指“事情”？请举例说明。
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想当别人干涉你的私事时，你可能会说“这不关你的事”，这里的“事”就是business。

sentences: He went to Shanghai on a ___ trip and visited many factories.

image_prompts: A teacher standing in front of a student who is writing lines on the blackboard as punishment.
A man paying a fine at a police station after being punished for speeding.
words.image_desc_en: A classroom scene: a teacher looks sternly at a student writing sentences on the board.
words.image_desc_cn: 教室场景：老师严厉地看着一个学生正在黑板上抄写句子。
words.collocations: punish sb for, severely punish, punish crime, punish by fine

examples.en: The teacher will punish the student who copied homework.
examples.cn: 老师会惩罚抄袭作业的学生。

examples.en: In some countries, people are punished for littering in public places.
examples.cn: 在一些国家，在公共场所乱扔垃圾会受到处罚。

socratic_questions.question: 如果一个人因为“punish”而改正了错误，你觉得惩罚的目的仅仅是让人痛苦吗？它还可能有什么作用？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想想惩罚能否帮助人认识到错误、学会承担责任。

sentences: Parents should not ___ their children too harshly for small mistakes.

image_prompts: A teacher pointing at a warning sign in a school corridor.
A weather forecaster on TV pointing to a map showing a typhoon path.
words.image_desc_en: A teacher warning students by pointing at a sign. A weather forecaster warning about a typhoon.
words.image_desc_cn: 一位老师指着告示牌警告学生。一位天气预报员在警告台风来临。
words.usage: 动词，意为“警告；告诫”，常用于 warn sb (not) to do sth 或 warn sb about/of sth 结构。
words.collocations: warn sb about, warn sb of, warn against, warn off

examples.en: The teacher warned us not to run in the hallway.
examples.cn: 老师警告我们不要在走廊里跑。

examples.en: The weather forecast warned of a coming typhoon.
examples.cn: 天气预报警告台风即将来临。

socratic_questions.question: 如果你看到朋友在做危险的事，你会怎么警告他？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以用“warn...against...”这个结构来表达。

sentences: The sign ___ people not to swim here.

image_prompts: A girl holding a beautifully wrapped gift with a smile.
A calendar with today's date circled and the words 'present moment' written below.
words.image_desc_en: A girl holding a birthday present. A calendar highlighting the current date.
words.image_desc_cn: 一个女孩拿着生日礼物。一张日历突出显示今天的日期。
words.usage: 名词（礼物；现在）或形容词（现在的；出席的）。形容词时常见于 be present at。
words.collocations: birthday present, present situation, at present, present for

examples.en: She received a beautiful present for her birthday.
examples.cn: 她收到了一个漂亮的生日礼物。

examples.en: We should focus on the present moment and enjoy it.
examples.cn: 我们应该专注于当下，享受它。

socratic_questions.question: 如果朋友忘记了你的生日礼物，你会怎么用“present”来表达你的失望？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以用“forget to give a present”或者“no present”。

sentences: She received many ___ on her birthday.

image_prompts: An empty classroom with desks and chairs but no students.
A person walking alone on a long, empty road.
words.image_desc_en: An empty classroom. A person walking alone on a road.
words.image_desc_cn: 一间空教室。一个人独自走在路上。
words.usage: 代词，意为“没有人”，相当于 no one。用作主语时谓语用单数。
words.collocations: nobody else, nobody knows, nobody cares, nobody noticed

examples.en: Nobody was in the classroom after school.
examples.cn: 放学后教室里没有人。

examples.en: Nobody can predict what will happen tomorrow.
examples.cn: 没有人能预测明天会发生什么。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么有时候说“nobody”比说“no one”听起来更口语化？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 可以想一想“nobody”和“no one”的音节和日常使用频率。

sentences: ___ knows the answer to this question.

image_prompts: A glowing campfire with logs burning, warming a group of people.
A person wrapped in a blanket, holding a hot cup of tea in a cozy room.
words.image_desc_en: A campfire providing warmth to people. A person feeling warm with a blanket and hot tea.
words.image_desc_cn: 篝火给人们带来温暖。一个人裹着毯子，喝着热茶，感觉很暖和。
words.usage: 不可数名词，意为“温暖；暖和”，可指温度或情感上的温暖。
words.collocations: body warmth, warmth of the sun, feel warmth, provide warmth

examples.en: The warmth of the sun felt great after a cold winter.
examples.cn: 寒冷的冬天过后，阳光的温暖真舒服。

examples.en: Her kind words brought warmth to my heart.
examples.cn: 她友好的话语让我心里感到温暖。

socratic_questions.question: “温暖”既可以指温度，也可以指情感。你能举出一个体现情感温暖的例子吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 回忆朋友或家人给你鼓励或安慰的时刻。

sentences: The ___ of the fire made us feel comfortable.

image_prompts: Wildfire flames spreading across a dry grassland.
A hand spreading peanut butter on a slice of bread with a knife.
words.image_desc_en: Flames spreading across a grassland. A hand spreading peanut butter on bread.
words.image_desc_cn: 火焰在草地上蔓延。一只手正在在面包上涂抹花生酱。
words.usage: 动词（传播；展开；涂）或名词（传播；蔓延）。过去式和过去分词均为 spread。
words.collocations: spread news, spread butter, spread disease, spread out

examples.en: The news spread quickly all over the school.
examples.cn: 消息很快传遍了整个学校。

examples.en: She spread jam on a piece of bread for breakfast.
examples.cn: 她早餐时把果酱涂在一片面包上。

socratic_questions.question: 为什么“传播”和“涂”用同一个词“spread”？你能想象它们动作上的共同点吗？
socratic_questions.answer_hint: 想象一下把果酱抹开和把消息扩散出去，动作都是向四周展开。

sentences: Last year, the disease ___ to many countries.
